title: How to Retrieve Your BVN With Your Phone Number in Nigeria
excerpt: Lost your Bank Verification Number? Here's how to retrieve your BVN online using Ufriends IT or check it on your phone using official USSD codes.

sections.content: Your Bank Verification Number (BVN) is the single most important security key for your financial profile in Nigeria. Issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), this 11-digit number links all your bank accounts, credit profiles, and mobile wallets to your biometric details. Because of its importance, you need it for almost everything: opening a new business account, upgrading your transfer limits, applying for a loan, or registering on fintech payment apps. Without a BVN, you cannot engage in any modern financial transactions in Nigeria, nor can you access credit or update your KYC profiles.

If you did your registration years ago, there is a high chance you have lost the slip given to you by the bank, or you cannot remember the number. Standing in line at a bank branch for hours just to ask a customer service representative to look up your number is a huge waste of time, especially during peak banking hours when bank halls are packed with customers. This stress is completely unnecessary in the modern age of digital services. Many bank branches are understaffed, meaning a simple look-up task can consume half your work day, which could have been spent on productive business tasks.

In this guide, we show you the official, instant ways to retrieve your BVN on your phone using simple USSD codes and how to retrieve and print your full details online without stress using Ufriends IT. This will save you from having to visit bank branches and deal with long queues, letting you retrieve your ID in under two minutes. Whether you are using a smartphone or a basic feature phone, we have got you covered, breaking down all the required steps and charges clearly.

Having your BVN ready is also critical during regulatory updates. When the CBN announces compliance audits, banks are quick to restrict accounts that do not have their linkage confirmed. Knowing how to retrieve your number instantly will protect you from unexpected transaction blocks, ensuring your online business transactions and payroll flows remain active.

sections.content: What Does BVN Retrieval Mean?

BVN retrieval is the process of querying the central bank database to recover your registered 11-digit verification number and print your profile sheet. Your profile sheet is a document that shows your full name, photograph, registered date of birth (DOB), and telephone number. Banks frequently request this document to verify your profile details before they can modify errors on your account. It is the core proof of identity that links all your commercial bank listings across the Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System. Without this central lookup, banks cannot validate if an account owner is the actual enrollee.
Why You Need Your BVN Profile Sheet

Simply knowing your 11-digit BVN is often not enough. When you request bank account upgrades or need to modify details on your bank profile, banks require your physical BVN profile sheet. This document has your biometric photograph and registered birth year, serving as proof that the account belongs to you. Generating a PDF copy of this sheet is critical to resolving bank restrictions. It is also required when registering for credit agencies, upgrading fintech merchant accounts, or validating business bank details with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) for business listings.
Method 1: Checking Your BVN via USSD Code (All Networks)

The fastest way to look up your 11-digit BVN on your phone screen is by using the official harmonized USSD code. This method requires no internet connection and works on basic phones. It is highly convenient for quick lookups when you are at a bank or filling a form in an office:

items: Open the call dialer on the phone that has the SIM card registered to your bank account.
Dial *565*0# and press call. This works on MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile.
Wait a few seconds for the network prompt. The system will display your 11-digit BVN directly on your screen.

Important Note: This service is not free. It charges a flat fee of ₦20, which is deducted from your regular mobile airtime balance (MTN, Airtel, Glo, or 9mobile). Ensure you have at least ₦20 airtime on your line before dialing. This code only works if you dial it from the exact phone number linked to your bank account. If you dial from an unlinked line, the transaction fails.

sections.content: What to Do If You Lost the SIM Card Linked to Your BVN

If the SIM card registered to your BVN is lost, blocked, or recycled, you cannot use the USSD code. You must visit your telecom provider's outlet with your ID and a police report to recover your old phone number, or visit a branch of the bank where you registered the BVN to link a new phone number to your BVN profile. Once updated, you can use the USSD and online retrieval tools again. Do not ignore a lost SIM, as it is a major security risk for your bank accounts, letting hackers potentially hijack your mobile verification feeds or execute bank transfers.
Common Rejection Reasons and Troubleshooting
If the system fails to retrieve your BVN online, review these common issues to troubleshoot the error:

items: Mismatched Names: If your bank account is registered as 'John Paul Doe' but you type 'Jon Doe' on the form, the database check will fail. Type your names exactly as they were registered during your biometrics capture. Spellings are checked character-by-character.

Unlinked Phone Numbers: Ensure the phone number you input matches the exact number you registered during your biometric capture. If you have changed your primary phone line at the bank, use the updated number.

NIBSS Server Downtime: Occasionally, NIBSS servers experience connectivity lag due to high database query traffic. If your request is pending, wait a few minutes and refresh your dashboard history tab.

sections.content: Why Keep Your BVN Confidential? (Security Protocols)

Your BVN is the key to your financial identity. While it does not allow someone to withdraw money from your account directly, bad actors can use your BVN to verify your details, open fake accounts in your name, or attempt social engineering attacks. Never share your BVN with unverified agents on social media who claim they can update your bank accounts or clear restrictions. Only use trusted, secured aggregators like Ufriends IT to manage your slips and modifications. Furthermore, ensure you log out of public computers after downloading your slip to prevent third-party access.
The Role of NIBSS in Financial Integrations

The Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System (NIBSS) acts as the bridge connecting every financial institution in Nigeria. When you open a bank account, register a POS terminal, or register for an online wallet, the provider queries NIBSS to confirm that your biometric record (represented by the BVN) matches the input details. Because of this centralized structure, keeping your NIBSS profile clean, updated, and accessible is crucial. If there is a lag on the NIBSS backend, all banking transactions linked to your identity can experience verification delays.

sections.content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

items: What is the USSD code to check my BVN? The official USSD code to check your BVN is *565*0#. It works across MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile networks, charging a flat ₦20 fee.

Does checking my BVN share my bank account balances? No, the database check only displays identity details. It does not expose your bank balances or account transactions.

Why was my online retrieval request pending? When central NIBSS servers experience connectivity issues, the Ufriends IT admin team retrieves the slip manually. This process usually completes within a few minutes.
Can I download my BVN slip as a PDF? Yes, once retrieved, the Ufriends IT portal provides an instant download link to save your BVN profile sheet as a high-quality PDF.
What is the funding fee on Ufriends IT? Ufriends IT charges a simple 1% fee on automated virtual bank transfers, with funds crediting in under 15 seconds.

How do I link my BVN to my NIN? Once you retrieve your BVN, you can use Ufriends IT's NIN Modification and slip tools to verify that all details match, then link them through your bank's online portal or at a branch.

What if I registered my BVN with an old number I no longer use? If the old number is permanently lost, you must visit a branch of the bank where you registered the BVN to perform a phone number modification before you can retrieve it online.
Is my data safe on Ufriends IT? Yes, Ufriends IT uses bank-grade secure socket layer (SSL) encryption to protect your identity details and data uploads.
Can I print BVN slips for my customers? Yes! Ufriends IT allows agent and reseller accounts, letting you retrieve and print slips for your customers at discounted rates to earn extra income.
What details show up on the retrieved BVN slip? The retrieved PDF slip displays your full name, 11-digit BVN, photograph, date of birth, phone number, gender, and the bank where you enrolled.

How do I resolve a name mismatch after retrieving my BVN? If you find spelling errors on your retrieved BVN slip, navigate to Ufriends IT's BVN Modification page to submit a correction request online.
Can I check my BVN balance? No, BVN is not a bank account and does not hold funds. It is strictly an identity number. You can only check your bank balance via your bank app or bank USSD.

Is there a limit to how many times I can retrieve my BVN slip? No, once you generate the slip on Ufriends IT, it is saved in your transaction history, allowing you to re-download it as many times as you like for free.
